product_summary: Real product lines per company website (cupidlimited.com, pages: /cupid-male-condom/, /cupid-female-condom/, /water-based-lubricant-jelly/, /ivd-products/, homepage product grid): (1) male latex condoms — plain 49/53 mm, dotted, ribbed, multi-textured, extra-large, ultra-thin, flavoured/coloured; (2) female condom — natural rubber latex sheath with octagonal polyethylene outer ring and polyurethane foam retainer; (3) water-based lubricant jelly in 3/5 ml sachets and 20/50/82/114 g tubes (mfg since 2015, FDA India 2015, CE 2016, capacity 210 mn sachets/yr); (4) IVD rapid test kits — pregnancy, LH ovulation, typhoid, dengue IgG/IgM, dengue NS1, dengue combo, HBsAg, HCV, malaria Pf-Pv, malaria Pf-PAN, syphilis, HIV 1&2, HIV/syphilis combo, viral transport medium; (5) consumer/personal-care lines on homepage: male deo & perfume, Angel female deo & fragrances, face wash with AHA, almond hair oil, hair removal sprays (men/women), reusable menstrual cup (CupiSafe), pregnancy kit (CupiSure), toilet seat spray. Manufacturing site: A-68 MIDC Sinnar, Nashik, Maharashtra.
comment: Declared HS 401410 is CORRECT for the core business (male condoms of vulcanised rubber) — exact match on the flagship line, hence 'partial' overall because the declaration covers only one of at least five distinct product families. Industry claimed as 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas / chemicals) is a clear MISCLASSIFICATION: the company is a personal-hygiene / contraceptive / medical-diagnostics manufacturer (rubber goods + cosmetics + IVD reagents), not petrochemicals. Missing from the declaration: female condom (rubber/plastic article, 401490 or 392690 depending on constituent material — the polyethylene ring and PU foam retainer make classification non-obvious), water-based lubricant jelly (cosmetic/body prep, 3304/3307 class, not 4014), IVD diagnostic kits (3822/3002 class), deodorants/perfumes/hair oil/face wash/hair-removal spray (Chapter 33/34), menstrual cup (9619/3924). No trader signs: own factory, own brands, in-house R&D centre, WHO/UNFPA prequalified, states export to >100 countries — consistent with a manufacturer-exporter, not a trader. Per project rule 3, the HS scope gap is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained, code 401410 confirmed as the primary/factual code and the additional codes above should be added to the declaration. All product claims above are from the company's own website and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line or B/L record was checked in this HS-only pass (out of scope per role), so actual shipment-level corroboration of each HS line remains null/unverified. No registry, revenue or volume data researched by design.
